positions.title: Product Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Work closely with extensive vehicle telemetry data to provide valuable insights into the quality/reliability and performance of Rivian's different products.
- Develop statistical and machine learning models for the practical purpose of predicting and forecasting field failures, contributing to Rivian's commitment to quality and safety.
- Take the lead in implementing ML-based Prognostics and Health Management to enhance preventative maintenance strategies, ensuring the longevity and sustainability of Rivian's products.
Engage in methodical research of algorithms, focusing on prototyping, validation, and iterative improvement, all while maintaining a practical approach to technological advancements.
- Serve as a respected technical authority within the organization, offering pragmatic guidance on current and future technology decisions, always aligned with Rivian's company's goals.
- Apply a deep understanding of the business and operational aspects of technology choices, ensuring a balanced approach that meets Rivian's company's needs efficiently.
- Foster collaboration among engineering peers by creating well-structured, adaptable designs and code that promote teamwork and practical solutions.
- Demonstrate ability to facilitate consensus during complex technical discussions, ensuring that Rivian maintains a productive and cooperative working environment.
